editor.viewHint: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right button to move. Decor colours are approximate and the texture is procedural.
editor.drillTitle: Where each hinge, handle and slide goes
editor.drillNote: The hinge schemes come from the official documents of Blum, Hettich, GTV and Salice. The cup distance C is calculated from the manufacturer's overlay formula, so the door overlaps exactly as in the model. Slide holes follow the GTV and Blum templates. Values marked “our choice” are decisions of the program where the document says nothing.
editor.nestNote: MaxRects nesting with best fit; parts with grain are not rotated. Each decor goes on separate sheets — for a small order, use cutting to size or offcuts.
editor.drawNote: First-angle projection (European), sizes in mm. The drawing number comes from the hash of the specification.
editor.safetyText: Zero point: X0 Y0 at the lower left corner of the sheet, Z0 on its top surface. Tool numbers are a sample machine profile. Simulate in the machine's software and do a dry run.
editor.cncBlockedText: The construction checks found errors, and G-code and DXF must never be wrong. Fix them — this tab unlocks by itself:
editor.cncBlockedLink: the construction has errors — see the CNC tab
editor.catSearch: Search by name, brand, code, shop…
editor.catNote: Prices and availability come from the shops' public pages on the catalogue date and may have changed — check them when you order. “Drillable” means there is a documented hole scheme.
